guest_question: I booked a non-refundable rate but my work trip got cancelled, is there any way to get my money back?
reference_answer: Denied. Under the Non-refundable policy within 'Guest cancellation tiers', guests receive a 10% discount at booking in exchange for forfeiting refund eligibility. Cancellations for any reason, including cancelled work trips or changed travel plans, receive no refund of the nightly rate or any fee.

guest_question: The chatbot already told me yesterday I'd get a full refund on my non-refundable booking, so when will that come through?
reference_answer: Denied. The booking was confirmed under the Non-refundable rate. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers', non-refundable reservations qualify for no refund of the nightly rate or fees upon guest cancellation. Unauthorized or erroneous bot statements do not override published policy terms; no refund will be issued.

guest_question: My daughter got sick and we can't travel, I picked the no-refund option but surely there's an exception?
reference_answer: Denied. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers' for Non-refundable bookings, cancellations for any reason—expressly including medical emergencies, personal illness, and changed plans—receive zero refund of the nightly rate or fees.

guest_question: Booked non-refundable and now the dates don't work for us, can I at least get the cleaning and service fee back?
reference_answer: Allowed in part. Under 'Service and cleaning fees', the cleaning fee is refunded whenever the guest cancels before check-in, on any tier. Because cancellation occurred on 2025-03-07 prior to the 2025-04-02 check-in (26 days in advance), the cleaning fee is refunded in full. However, the guest service fee and nightly rate are non-refundable because service fees are refunded only when a cancellation qualifies for a full refund under tier rules.

guest_question: There's been no hot water since we arrived and the host isn't responding, what am I owed here?
reference_answer: Allowed. Lack of hot water is an explicitly covered issue type under 'AirCover for guests' ('No hot water or other essential amenity missing'). Because the issue was reported within 72 hours of arrival and discovery, you qualify for AirCover protection, granting rebooking assistance and a partial or full refund for the affected nights based on severity.

guest_question: The place looks nothing like the photos, it's filthy and half the rooms are locked. I want a refund.
reference_answer: Allowed. Under 'AirCover for guests', 'Listing not as described' (including severe cleanliness deficiencies and inaccessible locked rooms) is a covered issue. Because you reported it within 72 hours of arrival, you are eligible for rebooking assistance and a refund for the affected nights based on severity.

guest_question: We couldn't get in at all, the code didn't work and nobody answered for hours so we booked a hotel.
reference_answer: Allowed. Under 'AirCover for guests', 'Could not check in' is a covered issue when reported within 72 hours of discovery. Because the access code failed, the host was entirely unreachable, and you were forced to book alternative lodging, you qualify for a full refund of the reservation and rebooking support.

guest_question: I found roaches in the kitchen on our first night three days ago but only reporting it now, can I still claim?
reference_answer: Denied. Under 'AirCover for guests', claims must be reported within 72 hours of discovery. Because the pest issue was discovered on the first night (2025-03-05) and reported on 2025-03-10 (5 days / 120 hours later), the claim exceeds the strict 72-hour reporting window and is not eligible for an AirCover refund.

guest_question: I need to cancel a few weeks out, my policy is moderate, how much of the total do I get back?
reference_answer: Allowed. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers' for Moderate listings, cancelling at least 5 days before check-in entitles the guest to a full refund of the nightly rate. Because cancellation was requested on 2025-03-03 for a 2025-03-25 check-in (22 days before check-in, exceeding the 5-day requirement), you receive a 100% full refund of the nightly rate, cleaning fee, and service fee.

guest_question: Cancelling my flexible booking today, check-in isn't until next month, do I lose anything?
reference_answer: Allowed. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers' for Flexible listings, cancelling at least 24 hours before check-in entitles the guest to a full refund of the nightly rate. Because you are cancelling on 2025-03-06 for a 2025-04-10 check-in (35 days before arrival), you will not lose anything and receive a 100% full refund including all fees.

guest_question: I have a firm policy and need to cancel about two weeks before arrival, what's the refund amount?
reference_answer: Allowed in part. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers' for Firm listings, cancelling 7 to 29 days before check-in entitles the guest to a 50% refund of the nightly rate. Because cancellation occurred on 2025-03-08 for a 2025-03-24 check-in (16 days before check-in), you receive 50% of the nightly rate plus 100% of the cleaning fee. Under 'Service and cleaning fees', partial refunds do not return the guest service fee.

guest_question: Booked a strict listing 40 hours ago and now I have to cancel, check-in is 10 days out, what do I get back?
reference_answer: Allowed in part. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers' for Strict listings, a full refund requires cancelling within 48 hours of booking AND at least 14 days before check-in. While cancelled 40 hours after booking, check-in is only 10 days away (2025-03-04 to 2025-03-14), failing the 14-day condition. Because cancellation is at least 7 days before check-in, the 50% rule applies: you receive 50% of the nightly rate and the full cleaning fee. The service fee is non-refundable.

guest_question: My host just cancelled on me the night before check-in and I have nowhere to stay, what happens now?
reference_answer: Allowed. Under 'Host cancellations', when the host cancels, the guest receives a full refund of everything paid, including the service fee. Furthermore, because the host cancelled within 30 days of check-in, AirCover will actively help you rebook a similar stay.

guest_question: Host cancelled my reservation this morning saying the place is unavailable, do I get everything back?
reference_answer: Allowed. Under 'Host cancellations', whenever a host cancels a reservation, the guest receives a full refund of everything paid, including the nightly rate, cleaning fee, and service fee. You get 100% of your money back.

guest_question: I booked a non-refundable rate and the host went and cancelled it themselves, am I stuck losing the money?
reference_answer: Allowed. You will not lose your money. Under 'Host cancellations', when the host cancels, the guest receives a full refund of everything paid, including the service fee. This rule applies on every tier, including Non-refundable, and overrides all tier cancellation restrictions.

guest_question: The host cancelled two days ago and I still haven't seen a refund, can you check on it?
reference_answer: Allowed. Because your host cancelled the reservation, you are entitled to a 100% full refund of everything paid, including the service fee, under 'Host cancellations'. The full refund is confirmed and being processed.

guest_question: Host is demanding an extra night fee because we left at 2pm instead of 11am, do I really have to pay that?
reference_answer: Denied. Staying past the agreed checkout time (leaving at 2pm instead of 11am) is not a covered cancellation or AirCover issue. Under 'AirCover for guests', protection applies exclusively to four defined categories (check-in failure, listing not as described, essential amenities missing, or pests). Issues outside these four categories are ineligible for refunds or fee waivers under this policy.

guest_question: We decided to leave a night early because we were done with our trip, can I get that last night refunded?
reference_answer: Denied. Under 'Guest cancellation tiers', the Firm policy covers only cancellations made before check-in and contains no rule or wording granting a refund for early departures or cancellations after check-in. Because the guest checked in on 2025-03-04 and requested cancellation after check-in on 2025-03-06, no refund is provided under the policy.

guest_question: The listing said checkout was noon but the host says 10am and charged me a late fee, is that allowed?
reference_answer: Denied. Disputes regarding checkout times and host-assessed late fees do not qualify under 'AirCover for guests'. AirCover covers only four explicit issues (unable to check in, listing not as described, missing essential amenities, or pests). Any issue that is not one of these four covered types is not eligible for an AirCover refund, whatever the timing.

guest_question: Our flight was delayed so we stayed past checkout by an hour, now there's a fee on my account, can it be waived?
reference_answer: Denied. Overstaying checkout due to travel or flight delays does not fall within covered cancellation tiers or the four eligible categories of 'AirCover for guests'. Consequently, the assessed late checkout fee cannot be waived or refunded under this policy.
